headline: Fed Holds Rates Steady Amid Persistent Inflation Concerns
summary: Democrats blame Trump for rising inflation while conservatives tout tax relief and fiscal concerns grow across the spectrum.

voices.quote: Food prices under The Affordability President just hit a 50 year high. I’m trying to remember what promises he made about grocery prices during the campaign. Anyone remember?

Americans are paying more for groceries, rent, and gas.

What’s President Trump doing? He and his grifting family are cashing in and getting richer.
I'm still amazed that Americans voted for Trump over Biden on the economy when Biden's economy was far, far stronger than what he inherited from Trump and what Trump has now done since.

New polling finds that only a quarter of Trump voters believe the working class got substantial tax breaks from the GOP's Big Ugly Bill.
